video_title: Gilbert Arenas & Melo Debate Bam Adebayo Punching Tyler Herro, Gil Tells Herro to Fight Back

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas argues big men shouldn't hit guards
quotes.excerpt: I don't like when big men hit guards. You already know we can't fight.

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: I'm just going to be honest, because I'm a guard. I don't like when big men hit guards. You already know we can't fight. We all living in this, we all living in here.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: Where you biased? Where you biased?

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: I can fight my size. I'm not fighting big men. Your job is to protect. We are the little ones. We just run our mouths, that's what we do. You all do the physical. So you coming all the way to Summer League to put your hands on me? I don't respect you no more.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on the consequences of teammates hitting him
quotes.excerpt: If Chris Mills, Danny Fortson, Mark Jackson, if they ever hit me with their power, we're not friends no more.
quotes.quote: I know what I did as a freshman, as a rookie and sophomore. If Chris Mills, Danny Fortson, Mark Jackson, if they ever hit me with their power, we're not friends no more. Now we're enemies and I got to do something to you for real.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the sanctity of teammate relationships
quotes.excerpt: Not to somebody that you spent eight years with, that we don't been in a bunker with.
quotes.quote: You done said some shit in your time, you done did some shit in your time. Not to somebody that you spent eight years with, that we don't been in a bunker with, that we don't went to the Eastern Conference Finals and Finals. We been the lone wolf over here ourselves while the rest of the league is moving on. How can you put that out there? How are you talking to a random person?

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas advises Tyler Herro to fight back
quotes.excerpt: When Caesar started manning and you all played it, you got to slap him.
quotes.quote: When Caesar started manning and you all played it, you got to slap him. On open hand. Soon as they getting ready to jump ball, you just want to just get out of there. You done, we don't all seen it, we going to run with the narrative, you beat him up. That's it.
